title: Crawford's recent hospital stay and diet
summary: Crawford describes his checkups, a recent hospital stay after dropping to 129 pounds, and his diet.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: And I get periodic checkups quite often. My organs are absolutely normal, liver, kidney, heart, no cardiac condition. I'm in good, normal -- I'm in good, normal condition. I'm talking like this -- I want to say it right. Yes, I go right down on the corner there.
And I was just released from the hospital, and naturally every day they're taking blood from me. I'd be so hungry, but yet they would hold up my breakfast. I wake up hungry all the time.
What were you in the hospital for?

Well, loss of weight, from 168 pounds down to 129, swollen feet. So that's what caused me to go in the hospital. So they brought me slowly but surely back, weight problem. Since I've been home, I've gained. I weigh now about 155 or 60.

See, they were starving me in the hospital, when I was on a strict diet, strict diet. I had to be on it. So I was eating what I was supposed to eat, staying -- sticking with my diet. And I still stick with it to a certain degree. I wanted some waffles this morning. I had some yesterday morning, but I didn't like the taste of the syrup. It was that dietary stuff, low sugar. It was bitter. So I wanted an old (inaudible) old man. So I asked my wife would she go out and bring me a bottle of Karo Syrup.
Well, I got to try it sometime. You know, won't throw me off that much. But I try my utmost to stick with my diet. Yeah, I was down to 129 pounds.
Yeah, that's quite a loss of weight.
